headline: No school changed tier this run. UC Berkeley's Course Credit CPT pause remains indefinite — the international office once said it hoped to resume within a week, but no resumption has followed. Tripwires unchanged; Davidson, MIT and Skidmore remain the only schools interrupting already-granted CPT. Both research queues remain empty.

tripwires.name: DHS SEVIS Help Hub CPT page
tripwires.detail: Direct fetch succeeded again 18 Sept 02:03 HKT. Page still marked 'Last Updated: August 24, 2026'; standard unchanged ('integral part of an established curriculum', relates to major — not stated as required for all students), same BCM 2608-01/2608-02 broadcast-message references as last run. Guidance page: still says SEVP plans to release draft guidance, no date. No change detected.

tripwires.name: Tufts I-Center CPT page
tripwires.detail: Direct fetch succeeded again 18 Sept 02:03 HKT — text unchanged from last run: the I-Center 'is unable to process CPT requests for non-required internships at this time.' No reversal.

tripwires.name: Federal Register rulemaking on CPT
tripwires.detail: None found 18 Sept 02:03 HKT. Only rulemaking surfaced is the 17 July 2026 fixed-time-period-of-admission (duration-of-status) rule, out of scope. CPT remains guidance (12 and 24 Aug broadcast messages), not a rule.

tripwires.name: Retroactive cancellation spreading
tripwires.detail: Checked 18 Sept 02:03 HKT via newspaper, .edu, 1point3acres and zhihu sweeps. Still only Davidson (15 Aug) and MIT have formally cancelled/withdrawn already-approved CPT. Skidmore's pause tells students already mid-internship to stop working and await individual guidance — the closest any school has come to a third cancellation, but framed as an individual-review hold, not a blanket revocation. No new cancellation found this run. Watching closely.

context: No CPT-specific litigation. No third broadcast message. DHS's stated position: 'nothing about these regulations has changed.' ICE is auditing schools, with SEVP decertification as the stated risk. Immigration attorneys flag a retroactive-scrutiny risk — past CPT revisited at the OPT, STEM-OPT or H-1B stage. The common institutional reading of the new standard: integral to the curriculum, required of all students in the programme for degree completion, a documented cooperative agreement with the employer, and DSO authorisation before training begins.

runs.summary: No school changed tier. UC Berkeley's Course Credit CPT pause re-verified via the Daily Cal — still indefinite, no resumption confirmed despite the office once hoping to resume within a week. U Chicago and Pomona re-verified clear on their own pages. Dartmouth re-verification attempt failed (URL 404), note unchanged. Tripwires unchanged, no new cancellations, no counter-trend.

NYU moves from unstated to honoured: its own CPT page (updated 8 Sept) says already-approved Fall 2026 CPT 'remains valid' under the existing I-20 and may continue, while new CPT needs an explicit mandatory-for-all degree requirement. Northwestern and Purdue re-verified restricted on their own pages/newspaper, existing-approval treatment still unaddressed. Hillsdale parked (unresolved) after a third failed search; both queues now empty. Tripwires unchanged, no new cancellations, no counter-trend.

No school changed tier. UCLA's posture newly sourced and verified on the Dashew Center's own Immigration Updates page (8 Sept notice) — indefinite suspension of certain CPT authorizations citing both August broadcast messages; existing-approval treatment not addressed.
